plan.title: [framework-gap] Grok Bot cannot attach to and steer an already-open Grok Build session over ACP

narratives.Description: Grok Bot attaches to a live Grok Build session over machine-local ACP with leader-first enrollment, permission ownership, and doctor attach-readiness. Launch-only propose/launch/status from #4201/#4202 stays unchanged.
narratives.Overview: Prefer-A Bound Recut-4 6328376098 for host-grokbot ACP attach.
narratives.Labels: enhancement, agent-experience, grok-build, harness, runtime-portability, urgent, design-critique:ingest-ready, framework-gap
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want Grok Bot on my phone to attach to the Grok Build session already open on my desk, so that phone replies drive that same live session without restarting it or copying credentials off the login machine.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add packages/core/src/grokbot-attach/index.ts, transport.ts, permissions.ts, bridge.ts and packages/core/src/grokbot-attach/attach.test.ts.
2. Enroll attach-readiness in packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts with packages/core/src/doctor/checks.test.ts.
3. Document attach/detach/failure modes in content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/references/host-grokbot.md.
4. CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry.

items.title: relieves: P1 — Leader-first shared-backend live attach with effective worker isolation: ensure a leader process before phone attach (grok agent leader / grok agent --leader / grok leader *; never grok --leader); enroll keep-alive with --no-exit-on-disconnect on that leader and isolated leader-*.sock owned by this attach arc; prefer per-client join that leaves machine-global use_leader untouched; if enrollment would enable global leader mode, require an effective house-worker opt-out for the entire attach window (unrelated grok workers remain outside the shared-leader route) — rollback-on-detach alone is insufficient — otherwise refuse that global-config enrollment path; detach closes bridge-owned resources only and never invokes machine-wide grok leader kill; doctor remedies name the arc socket not all leaders; reuse leader turn arbitration or busy-refuse; no blind resend; session/load labeled resume unless same-backend probe promotes it
